lead.headline: FIU rates highest, and Kennesaw State hasn't lost
lead.deck: Ten schools, from Delaware to Las Cruces. FIU and Sam Houston are the only two in our top 150.
body: Hardwood Bricks now covers Conference USA, ten schools that stretch from Newark, Delaware to Miami and west to Las Cruces. Every game gets a preview, a recap, a line history and a spot in our ratings.
FIU rates highest in the league at 125th and is 3-0. The Panthers won 89-80 at Florida Gulf Coast on Friday as 3.5-point underdogs.
Sam Houston (129th) is 2-2, with road losses at Alabama and Illinois around an 85-77 win over Pepperdine.
Kennesaw State is 4-0, the league's only other unbeaten team, with close wins over Austin Peay and Winthrop.
Liberty lost its opener to High Point on a neutral floor and has won twice since. Missouri State is 3-0, but all three wins came against non-Division I teams.

column.label: By the Numbers
column.title: Three numbers from the first two weeks
body: **3.** Points Western Kentucky lost by at Tennessee Tech, 97-94. The Golden Eagles are the SoCon's newest member.
**46.** Jacksonville State's margin of defeat at Houston. The Gamecocks bounced back to beat UAB 71-68 on Saturday.
**2.** CUSA teams in our national top 150, FIU and Sam Houston.

notes.headline: Middle Tennessee at home
notes.body: The Blue Raiders are 3-0 in Murfreesboro and lost by 44 at Kansas.

notes.headline: New Mexico State's week
notes.body: The Aggies lost by 41 at Gonzaga, then 60-58 at UTEP, their old league rival.

notes.headline: Delaware's opener
notes.body: The Blue Hens scored 105 on opening night, then lost at Wisconsin and at home to James Madison.

notes.headline: One bid
notes.body: The league tournament in March decides Conference USA's NCAA bid, so the regular season is about seeding.
